items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The LORD instructed Moses regarding a legal matter

items.quote: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp;
items.claim: The person who cursed was to be brought outside the camp

items.quote: and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head,
items.claim: All who heard the cursing were to lay their hands on the blasphemer's head
items.mechanism: lay their hands upon his head

items.quote: and let all the congregation stone him.
items.claim: The congregation was to stone the person
